'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Russian Ministry of Defence]] announces that [[Russian Armed Forces|its forces]] have captured the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] village of [[Tonenke]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/03/21/Russia-says-it-has-captured-the-village-of-Tonenke-in-eastern-Ukraine- (Al Arabiya)] 
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***[[Russia]] launches a massive attack on [[Kyiv]] and the [[Kyiv Oblast|surrounding region]] with [[Ballistic missile|ballistic]] and [[cruise missile]]s, injuring at least 17 people. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/03/21/europe/kyiv-missile-attack-ukraine-russia-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Mykolaiv strikes (2022–present)|Mykolaiv strikes]]
***At least one [[civilian]] is killed and four others are injured in a Russian ballistic missile attack on [[Mykolaiv]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-one-injures-four-ukraines-mykolaiv-officials-say-2024-03-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**[[2024 Kandahar New Kabul Bank bombing]]
***A [[suicide bomber]] kills 21 people and injures 50+ at a [[New Kabul Bank]] in [[Kandahar]], [[Afghanistan]]. [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|ISIS-K]] claims responsibility. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-187925 (TOLO News)]
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)]]
**The [[Islamic Resistance in Iraq]] launches drone attacks on [[Kiryat Shmona Airport]] and [[Ben Gurion Airport]] in [[Israel]]. [https://en.mehrnews.com/amp/212742/ (Mehr News Agency)] [https://en.irna.ir/amp/85422962/ (Islamic Republic News Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A capsized boat carrying [[Rohingya]] refugees is found off the coast of [[Aceh]], [[Indonesia]], with 69 refugees rescued. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2513612-boot-met-rohingyavluchtelingen-gekapseisd-bij-atjeh (NOS)]
*The death toll of the capsized [[South Korea]]n-flagged [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] {{MV|Keoyoung Sun||2}} increases to nine with one person still missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nine-dead-after-south-korean-flagged-vessel-capsized-off-japan-skorea-says-2024-03-21/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the European Union]]
**The [[European Council]] agrees to open talks on [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]'s membership of the [[European Union]] days after the recommendation by the [[European Commission]]. [https://apnews.com/article/eu-enlargement-bosnia-bid-candidate-western-balkans-e2862599316dea5973a4fd7b1a2781ee (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Russia]] sentences the [[Volga Maniac]] serial killer to [[life in prison]] for the murders of 31 elderly women in [[Tatarstan]] in 2011 and 2012. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/volga-maniac-gets-life-sentence-killing-31-russian-women-2024-03-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Pope Francis]] [[Loss of clerical state|laicizes]] [[Belgium|Belgian]] bishop [[Roger Vangheluwe]] due to allegations of abuse. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2513661-paus-zet-belgische-hoogbejaarde-bisschop-uit-ambt-vanwege-misbruik (NOS)]
*The [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Royal Marechaussee]] arrests three [[UK|British]] soldiers of the HMS {{HMS|Prince of Wales|R09|2}} after multiple incidents in [[Rotterdam]], Netherlands. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2513667-militairen-brits-vliegdekschip-aangehouden-voor-mishandeling-en-dronkenschap (NOS)]
*Filipino former [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|legislator]] [[Arnolfo Teves Jr.]] is arrested in [[Dili]], [[East Timor]], after being placed in the [[Interpol]] [[Red Notice]] in connection with his role in [[Pamplona massacre|the 2023 massacre]] in [[Negros Oriental]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/ex-lawmaker-accused-of-killing-philippine-governor-arrested-in-east-timor-de07aefc (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of Vietnam]] [[Võ Văn Thưởng]] resigns after just over a year in office amid the [[Communist Party of Vietnam|Communist Party]]'s [[Corruption in Vietnam#Government anti-corruption efforts|anti-corruption campaign]], making him the shortest-serving [[President of Vietnam|president]] in Vietnamese history. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/once-beacon-stability-vietnam-name-third-president-year-2024-03-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/20/vietnams-president-vo-van-thuong-resigns-amid-anti-corruption-campaign (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-03-20/vietnam-s-president-quits-in-latest-sign-of-leadership-turmoil (Bloomberg)]
